questions.text: Explain Big-M Method and Two-Phase Simplex Method for handling $\ge$ and $=$ constraints. Formulate the Dual of a given Primal LPP and state the Duality Theorems (Weak Duality, Strong Duality, Complementary Slackness Theorem).

Find the Initial Basic Feasible Solution (IBFS) of a Transportation Problem with 3 sources and 4 destinations using Vogel's Approximation Method (VAM). Test the optimality of the solution using the Modified Distribution (MODI / $u-v$) Method and find the minimum transportation cost.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Assignment Problem & Travelling Salesman Problem
questions.text: Explain the Hungarian Method for solving an $n \times n$ Assignment Problem. Solve an unbalanced assignment problem where 5 construction machines are to be assigned to 4 construction sites to minimize total cost.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Queueing Theory & Inventory Control Models
questions.text: Derive the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) formula: $EOQ = \sqrt{\frac{2 D C_o}{C_h}}$ under deterministic demand with instantaneous replenishment. An infrastructure firm has an annual demand of $10,000\,\text{bags}$ of cement. Ordering cost is $\text{NPR } 500\,\text{per order}$ and holding cost is $\text{NPR } 25\,\text{per bag per year}$. Calculate: (a) Optimal order quantity, (b) Number of orders per year, and (c) Total minimum annual inventory cost.

Solve a Two-Person Zero-Sum Game with payoff matrix: Find the Saddle Point if it exists (Maximin-Minimax principle). If no saddle point exists, reduce the $m \times n$ payoff matrix using the Principle of Dominance and solve the $2 \times 2$ mixed strategy game using algebraic / probability methods.
